verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device and hosted inference SDK/runtime, so serving multiple LoRA adapters on a base model is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions LoRA adapters, adapter loading or swapping, or multi-adapter serving. The pack covers tool calling, structured output, STT/TTS, NPU acceleration and an OpenAI-compatible cloud API, none of which addresses this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can efficiently serve multiple LoRA adapters on top of a base model
